title: Margamu Nene Annadu Yesu – Philip P Jacob Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: రానున్న రారాజు నా యేసు మహా రాజు
1.స్వస్థపరచే – నా మంచి యేసు స్వేచ్ఛనిచ్చే – నా మంచి యేసు
శ్వాసతో నింపే – నా మంచి యేసు హృదిలో చోటిస్తే నివసిస్తాడే
english: Raanunna Raraaju Naa Yeshu maha raaju
translation: Jesus said, “I am the Way”; Jesus said, “I am the Truth.”
Jesus said, “I am the Life”; He died and rose again for me.
He removed the sin within me, delivered me from the curse, and gave me life.
He filled me with the Holy Spirit, leads me with His power, and will bring me to my destination.
My Jesus is the Great King, the King who is to come.
1. My good Jesus is the healer; my good Jesus gives freedom.
My good Jesus fills me with health/inheritance; He dwells within if you give Him a place in your heart.
2. My good Jesus gives deliverance; my good Jesus gives victory.
My good Jesus conquers the enemy; He molded me into a hero of faith.
3. My good Jesus shed His blood; my good Jesus gave salvation.
My good Jesus called me to come and stay with Him forever.
intro: Margamu Nene Annadu Yesu is the latest Telugu Christian song written, tuned & composed by Paul Jayakumar Chinnababu Garu, sung by Philip P Jacob. This song was released on March 17, 2026, through Philadelphia AG Church Vijayawada YouTube Channel.
